description.zh:
单次请求返回结果的最大条数。

取值范围：1~100。默认值：10。
description.en:
The maximum number of entries to return for a single request.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10.
The token that is used to start the next query.

description.zh:
资源类型。

取值：Account，表示资源目录的成员。
description.en:
The resource type.

The value Account indicates the members of the resource directory.

description.zh: 标签键，用于查询的过滤条件。
description.en: The tag key. This parameter specifies a filter condition for the query.
The tag value for a fuzzy query.

title.zh: 查询指定标签键对应的标签值

descriptions.zh:
### 使用说明
本文将提供一个示例，查询标签键k1对应的标签值。返回结果显示：标签键k1对应的标签值为v1。
descriptions.en: This topic provides an example on how to call the API operation to query the tag values of the tag key k1. The response shows that the tag value of the tag key k1 is v1.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun resourcemanager list-tag-values --next-token TGlzdFJlc291cm0000 --max-results 10 --resource-type Account --tag-key k1 --value-filter v1 --api-version 2020-03-31 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun resourcemanager ListTagValues --region cn-hangzhou --NextToken TGlzdFJlc291cm0000 --MaxResults 10 --TagKey k1 --ResourceType Account --ValueFilter v1
